_comment_access: Access strategy: open | public | allowlist | code | approval (default). Runtime override via /access or set_access_strategy is persisted to data/access.json and overrides this.
_comment_allowlist: For allowlist strategy: list of allowed Telegram user IDs
_comment_accessCode: For code strategy: secret code users must send to get access
_comment_session: idleCompactMin: idle sessions over the threshold are compacted by the heartbeat sweep (0 = off). hardLimitPct: size-triggered compaction may interrupt a running task only above this % of contextBudgetChars.
_comment_contextBudget: Character budget for the always-on system prompt, per section. /context shows the actual split; start-up warns when a section overflows.
_comment_skills: selection: model (agent calls skill_load when a description fits) | keyword (legacy word overlap, fallback for one release). retainTurns: turns a loaded skill stays after its last use.
_comment_guard: Guardrails around tool calls. Rules are markdown files in rules/*.md; protected platform rules ship with the runtime. record rules append to recordFile, rotated at recordMaxBytes; observers slower than observerTimeoutMs are abandoned.
_comment_memory: limits: per-file character caps — oldest content is truncated from the top when exceeded (the ## Rules heading of SOUL.md is exempt). review: background self-improvement pass every everyTurns turns via the auxiliary LLM. instincts: learned behaviours with confidence — bands decide what a behaviour may do, reinforce/correct/decay move it, pinned ones never decay.
_comment_verification: After a mutating tool ran, the draft reply is checked against the tool outcomes by the auxiliary LLM before delivery; past timeoutMs the draft goes out marked unverified.
_comment_s3: Sync is event-driven (fs.watch + diff). syncIntervalSec is an optional periodic full-sweep safety net — set 0 to disable, or e.g. 21600 (6h) for paranoid backup.
_comment_managed: Files overwritten from .agent.example on every restart. Set to [] to disable.
_comment_syncSkills: Sync skills from .agent.example on restart. User-created skills are never deleted.
_comment_message: Caps on user message text handed to the model. maxCharsWithAttachments is deliberately far larger: a chat attachment arrives as a bounded preview the API already trimmed, and cutting it twice leaves the model a fragment of the file.
_comment_tools: maxOutputChars caps tool_call/tool_result payloads handed to the model; the full payload stays on disk. Keep it above a typical query_attachment read, or the model goes back to estimating from the preview.
